6d8b87ed: What is the largest country in the world by area?
Russia is the largest country in the world, with 17.1 million km², about 11% of the Earth's land area. It spans 11 time zones.
353df3ea: What is the highest mountain in the world?
Mount Everest rises to 8,849 m in the Himalayas, on the border between Nepal and China (Tibet). It was first climbed in 1953 by Edmund Hillary and Tenzing Norgay.
dadf9f14: What is the capital of Brazil?

Brasília has been Brazil's capital since 1960, built from scratch to move the capital from Rio de Janeiro to the center of the country. Its landmark buildings were designed by architect Oscar Niemeyer.
881af10f: Which is the largest ocean in the world?
The Pacific Ocean is the largest, covering about 165 million km², nearly half of the world's ocean surface and about a third of the Earth's total surface.
a22b561a: What is the smallest capital in the world by population?
Ngerulmud, the capital of Palau (Micronesia), has only a few hundred inhabitants and is considered the smallest national capital. Vatican City is a city-state rather than a conventional capital.
8ae39030: Which strait separates Europe from Africa?
The Strait of Gibraltar separates Spain (Europe) from Morocco (Africa), about 14 km wide at its narrowest point. It links the Atlantic to the Mediterranean.
5504e168: Which very narrow country stretches more than 4,000 km from north to south along the Pacific?
Chile stretches about 4,300 km from north to south, but averages less than 200 km in width, from the Atacama Desert in the north to Tierra del Fuego in the south.
65ab6568: What is the capital of New Zealand?
Wellington is New Zealand's capital, south of Auckland (the largest city). It is often called the windiest capital in the world.
1f7e0e5b: Which mountain range separates Europe from Asia?
The Ural Mountains are traditionally considered the border between Europe and Asia. About 2,500 km long, they run from northern Russia to Kazakhstan.
ddd8cfb6: How many departments does metropolitan France have?
Metropolitan France has 96 departments, numbered 01 (Ain) to 95 (Val-d'Oise), with Corsica split into two. Adding the 5 overseas departments gives a total of 101.
1601b50a: What is the largest island in the world?

Greenland is the largest island in the world, with about 2.1 million km². This autonomous territory of the Kingdom of Denmark is about 80% covered in ice. Australia, though larger, is considered a continent.
b3f6bc89: Which country has the longest coastline in the world?
Canada has the longest coastline, about 200,000 km including all its islands. Its Arctic archipelago accounts for much of this record.
8ad44e9a: Which sea is the saltiest in the world?
The Dead Sea is the saltiest, with a salinity of about 34%, nearly ten times that of the ocean. Its extreme salinity lets swimmers float effortlessly.
dead031c: What is the capital of Ukraine?
Kyiv is the capital of Ukraine, its largest city and its political, cultural and economic center. Traditionally dated to the 5th century, it is one of the oldest cities in Europe.
f8219289: What is the highest mountain in Africa?
Kilimanjaro, in Tanzania, rises to 5,895 m. This dormant volcano is capped by glaciers that are retreating with global warming.
fc9967eb: What is the capital of Canada?
Ottawa is the capital of Canada, not Toronto (the most populous city) or Vancouver. Queen Victoria chose it in 1857 as a compromise between English- and French-speaking Canada.
f3579d2a: Which is the most densely populated country in the world (excluding city-states)?
Bangladesh is the most densely populated country outside city-states, with around 1,300 people per km², concentrated on the Ganges-Brahmaputra delta.
10974f89: What is the capital of Kazakhstan?
Astana has been Kazakhstan's capital since 1997. It was called Nur-Sultan from 2019 to 2022. Almaty remains the largest city.
8aa8d118: Which strait links the Red Sea to the Indian Ocean?
The Bab-el-Mandeb (“Gate of Tears” in Arabic) links the Red Sea to the Gulf of Aden and the Indian Ocean, a strategic passage between Yemen and Djibouti through which huge volumes of oil travel.
2726d965: What is the highest mountain in the Americas?
Aconcagua, in Argentina, rises to 6,961 m, the highest peak in the Western Hemisphere and outside Asia. Denali is North America's highest at 6,190 m.
e32fc61e: Which country has the most lakes in the world?
Canada has more lakes than any other country, by some estimates more than half of all the lakes in the world.
4d594ab6: Which is the most densely populated country in mainland Africa?
Rwanda is the most densely populated country in mainland Africa, with around 500 people per km². Nigeria has the largest population (over 200 million), but its larger area gives it a lower density.
b4b608a7: Which territory in South America has French as its official language?
French Guiana is the only territory in South America with French as its official language. As an overseas department of France, it is part of the EU. Its capital is Cayenne.
50e85e65: What is the longest river in Asia?
The Yangtze is Asia's longest river, at about 6,300 km, and the third longest in the world after the Nile and the Amazon. It crosses China from the Tibetan Plateau to Shanghai.
b2e3125a: What is the name of the salt lake east of Israel that is the lowest on Earth?

The Dead Sea's shore is the lowest point on land, about 430 m below sea level. It is so salty that almost nothing lives in it and you float naturally. It is shared by Israel, Jordan and the West Bank.
fd6e9c2c: What is the capital of Thailand?
Bangkok is the capital of Thailand. Its full ceremonial name in Thai is one of the longest city names in the world.
5080b86a: Which country has the largest proven oil reserves in the world?
Venezuela has the largest proven oil reserves in the world, around 300 billion barrels, ahead of Saudi Arabia. However, its heavy crude and instability limit production.
8e6018cd: What is the largest enclosed body of water on the planet, even though it is called a “sea”?
The Caspian Sea is technically the largest lake in the world: despite its name, it has no outlet to the ocean. It is bordered by Russia, Azerbaijan, Iran, Turkmenistan and Kazakhstan.
261fa9ec: Which European Union country has the most land neighbors?
Germany shares borders with nine countries: Denmark, the Netherlands, Belgium, Luxembourg, France, Switzerland, Austria, Czechia and Poland.
598bd844: What is the capital of Argentina?

Buenos Aires is Argentina's capital and largest city, often nicknamed the “Paris of South America” for its European architecture, culture and nightlife. Its metropolitan area has about 15 million people.
ce858ba7: What is the largest archipelago in the world?

Indonesia has about 17,000 islands, around 6,000 of them inhabited. It is the world's largest archipelago and its fourth most populous country. Its main islands are Java, Sumatra, Borneo, Sulawesi and western New Guinea.
1a3315f7: What is the name of the highest plateau in the world?

The Tibetan Plateau (Qinghai-Tibet Plateau) is the highest and largest plateau in the world, averaging about 4,500 m over 2.5 million km². Nicknamed “the Roof of the World”, it is the source of many great Asian rivers.
fe5e8fef: How many countries make up the European Union in 2024?
The European Union has had 27 members since Brexit (the United Kingdom left in 2020). Its member states have about 450 million people and share a single market with free movement of people and goods.
c94812cd: What is the largest freshwater lake in the world by area?
Lake Superior (USA/Canada) is the largest freshwater lake by area, at about 82,000 km². Lake Baikal is the deepest and holds the most fresh water. Lake Victoria is Africa's largest lake.
3d10ec59: Which African country is known as the “Land of a Thousand Hills”?
Rwanda is nicknamed the “Land of a Thousand Hills” for its landscape of green hills. Since the 1994 genocide, it has achieved a remarkable economic recovery and is known for its cleanliness.
8f3f26ea: Which is the smallest ocean in the world?
The Arctic Ocean is the smallest ocean, about 14 million km², largely frozen. It surrounds the North Pole and is bordered by Russia, Canada, Norway, Greenland and Alaska.
cae69ea0: What was the tallest building in the world in 2024?
Dubai's Burj Khalifa (UAE) remained the world's tallest building at 828 m, opened in 2010. Merdeka 118 in Kuala Lumpur (679 m) has been second since 2023.
f6f74bef: What is the capital of Pakistan?
Islamabad has been Pakistan's capital since 1967, a planned city built to replace Karachi. Karachi remains the largest city and economic center.
f0c909f1: What is the name of the deepest trench in the Atlantic?
The Puerto Rico Trench is the deepest part of the Atlantic, about 8,376 m deep at the Milwaukee Deep. It lies at the boundary between the North American and Caribbean plates.
13f6d51b: Which country is called “Land of the Thunder Dragon” in its own language?

Bhutan calls itself Druk Yul, “Land of the Thunder Dragon”, and a dragon features on its flag. This small Himalayan kingdom between India and China measures Gross National Happiness and long kept tourism limited.
17038a5c: What is the largest country in South America?
Brazil is the largest country in South America, at 8.5 million km², about 47% of the continent and the fifth largest country in the world. The Amazon rainforest covers nearly half of its territory.
54b337bf: What is the name of the artificial canal linking the Mediterranean to the Red Sea?
Egypt's Suez Canal links the Mediterranean to the Red Sea. Opened in 1869 under Ferdinand de Lesseps, it is about 193 km long and spares ships the trip around Africa.
3fa3d1d9: In which country is Lake Titicaca, the highest navigable lake in the world?
Lake Titicaca is shared by Peru and Bolivia. At 3,812 m, it is often called the highest navigable lake in the world. Its floating Uros islands, built of reeds, are a unique attraction.
419deb13: Which Southeast Asian country has the largest area?
Indonesia is by far the largest country in Southeast Asia, at 1.9 million km², and also the most populous (about 280 million). Myanmar and Thailand follow far behind.
53174197: What is Africa's second-longest river, which crosses the DR Congo before flowing into the Atlantic?
The Congo River (Africa's second longest, about 4,700 km) flows into the Atlantic. It is unusual in crossing the equator twice, and its basin is the second largest in the world after the Amazon's.
ff41167e: What is the smallest state in the world?

Vatican City is the smallest recognized state in the world, at 0.44 km². An enclave within Rome, it is the seat of the Catholic Church and the Pope's residence. The Holy See has observer status at the UN.
52398004: What is the coldest desert in the world?
Antarctica is both the largest and the coldest desert in the world: a desert is defined by low precipitation, not heat. The Atacama is the driest non-polar desert.
11801ca1: What is the capital of Ethiopia?
Addis Ababa, perched at more than 2,300 m, is the capital of Ethiopia. It hosts the headquarters of the African Union.
ffde1b52: Which Portuguese archipelago in the Atlantic has Funchal as its capital?

Madeira is a Portuguese archipelago in the North Atlantic, volcanic islands about 1,000 km southwest of Lisbon and 520 km off Morocco. Its capital is Funchal, and it is known for its wine, flowers and levada trails.
7eec3c94: Which African countries escaped European colonization?
Ethiopia, which defeated Italy at Adwa in 1896, and Liberia, independent since 1847, escaped colonization. Ethiopia was nonetheless occupied by Italy from 1936 to 1941.
12a0fe6c: What is the highest temperature ever recorded on Earth?
Death Valley, California, holds the official record: 56.7°C (134°F), recorded on July 10, 1913, at Furnace Creek. The disputed 58°C reading from Libya (1922) is no longer recognized by the WMO.
4483973f: What is the capital of Nigeria, Africa's most populous country?
Abuja has been Nigeria's capital since 1991, built to replace Lagos. Lagos remains the largest city. Nigeria is Africa's most populous country, with more than 200 million people.
86353dc1: What is the longest river in Europe?
The Volga is Europe's longest river, about 3,530 km, flowing into the Caspian Sea in Russia. The Danube (about 2,850 km) is second, flowing through 10 countries.
ca830fc7: Which country has the most UNESCO World Heritage Sites?
Italy has the most World Heritage Sites, just ahead of China.
8de1f0cb: What are the vast grassy plains of Argentina called?
The Pampas are South America's great grassy plains, stretching mainly across Argentina, Uruguay and southern Brazil. This very fertile region is a major producer of beef and soybeans.
ff3effa9: Which South Asian country has Sri Jayawardenepura Kotte as its capital?
Sri Jayawardenepura Kotte is Sri Lanka's administrative capital, while Colombo remains the commercial capital and largest city.
f4b268af: Which African country has Dakar as its capital?
Dakar is the capital of Senegal, a port city on the Cap-Vert peninsula, the westernmost point of mainland Africa. It is known for mbalax music and was once the finish of the Dakar Rally.
9aec4a38: Which South American country does the Tropic of Capricorn cross?
The Tropic of Capricorn (about 23.4°S) crosses Brazil, passing near São Paulo. In South America it also crosses Paraguay, Argentina and Chile, as well as southern Africa, Madagascar and Australia.
18a27896: What is the capital of Mongolia?
Ulaanbaatar is Mongolia's capital, one of the coldest capitals in the world, where winter temperatures can drop to -40°C. About half of Mongolia's population lives there.
8f3360b0: What is the name of the American Pacific archipelago that includes Hawaii?
The Hawaiian archipelago has 137 islands; the 8 main ones include Hawaiʻi (the Big Island), Maui, Oʻahu (Honolulu) and Kauaʻi. It became the 50th U.S. state in 1959.
c9c9f18a: What is the longest glacier in the world outside the polar regions?
Tajikistan's Fedchenko Glacier is the longest glacier outside the polar regions, about 77 km long, in the Pamirs. The Baltoro (Karakoram, 63 km) and the Aletsch (23 km) follow.
cfe009c2: What is the capital of Finland?
Helsinki has been Finland's capital since 1812, a port city on the Baltic Sea, often confused with Stockholm (Sweden). Finland regularly tops the UN-backed World Happiness Report.
0313737a: Which continent has the largest land area?
Asia is the largest continent, with 44.6 million km², about 30% of the Earth's land. It is also home to about 60% of the world's population. Africa is second, with 30.4 million km².
f7e50c98: What is the longest defensive wall ever built?

The Great Wall of China measures about 21,196 km according to official surveys, built over more than 2,000 years by successive dynasties. Contrary to legend, it is NOT visible to the naked eye from space.
ffd16e4f: What is the name of the strait between Alaska and Russia that allowed the ancestors of Native Americans to migrate?

The Bering Strait separates Alaska (USA) from Siberia (Russia). During the ice ages, it formed a land bridge (Beringia) that let humans and animals migrate between Asia and the Americas. It is about 85 km wide today.
688084b8: Which is the highest capital or major city in the world?
La Paz, Bolivia, is the highest seat of government in the world, at about 3,640 m; Sucre is the constitutional capital but lies lower. Neighboring El Alto, above 4,000 m, is the highest major city.
b91d466b: Which country has the most time zones in the world?
France has the most time zones, 12, thanks to its overseas territories scattered around the world (French Polynesia, Réunion, French Guiana, etc.). Russia has 11.
0c6ae1f9: Which huge rift in East Africa could one day give birth to a new ocean?
The East African Rift is slowly pulling the African plate apart. In tens of millions of years, the Horn of Africa could break away, separated by a new ocean.
625868d1: What is the capital of South Korea?
Seoul is the capital of South Korea, a megacity of nearly 10 million people (about 25 million in the metropolitan area) and the country's economic, cultural and technological center.
30f48f63: What is the capital of Morocco?
Rabat has been Morocco's capital since 1912, during the French protectorate. It is often confused with Casablanca, the largest city and economic center.
0b4ee656: What is the capital of Portugal?
Lisbon, at the mouth of the Tagus, is the capital of Portugal.
1a2e0258: What is the capital of Egypt?
Cairo, on the Nile, is the largest city in the Arab world. The pyramids of Giza stand on its outskirts.
2f8a1548: What is the capital of Turkey?
Ankara has been Turkey's capital since 1923. Istanbul is the country's largest city, but not its capital.
e0860937: Which city is home to the Swiss government and parliament?
Bern is Switzerland's “federal city”. Zurich is the largest city, and Geneva hosts many international organizations.
74cf7408: What is the capital of Vietnam?
Hanoi, in the north, is the capital. Ho Chi Minh City, formerly Saigon, is the largest city.
df8c2152: What is the capital of Peru?
Lima, founded in 1535 by Francisco Pizarro, is the capital of Peru. Cusco was the capital of the Inca Empire.
4c52421b: What is the capital of Colombia?
Bogotá sits at more than 2,600 m in the Andes. Caracas is the capital of Venezuela.
e6537e84: What is the capital of Norway?
Oslo is the capital of Norway. Stockholm is Sweden's and Copenhagen Denmark's.
71b352a1: What is the capital of Ireland?
Dublin is the capital of the Republic of Ireland. Belfast is the capital of Northern Ireland, in the United Kingdom.
b21c70f0: What is the capital of Kenya?
Nairobi is the capital of Kenya. Kampala is Uganda's.
cf82f240: What is the capital of Iran?
Tehran, at the foot of the Alborz mountains, is the capital of Iran. Baghdad is the capital of Iraq.
a20d5468: What is the capital of the Philippines?
Manila, on the island of Luzon, is the capital of the Philippines. Jakarta is Indonesia's.
af178ae3: What is the capital of Chile?
Santiago is the capital of Chile. Valparaíso, a major port, is home to the National Congress.
685cdd06: What is the capital of Hungary?
Budapest was created in 1873 by merging Buda and Pest, on either side of the Danube.
74edd622: What is the capital of Croatia?
Zagreb is the capital of Croatia. Ljubljana is the capital of neighboring Slovenia.
0505b9cc: What is the capital of Ghana?
Accra, on the Gulf of Guinea, is the capital of Ghana. Lomé is the capital of Togo.
3dd3cd4e: What is the capital of Cuba?
Havana is the capital of Cuba. Santo Domingo is the capital of the Dominican Republic.
7db81acc: What is the capital of Poland?
Warsaw, on the Vistula, has been Poland's capital since the late 16th century. Kraków held the role before.
8dc9c039: What is the highest mountain in France?
Mont Blanc, in the Alps, rises to about 4,806 m. It is the highest peak in Western Europe.
043fb251: What is the longest river in France?
The Loire flows for about 1,000 km, from the Massif Central to the Atlantic.
818c61b1: How many regions has metropolitan France had since 2016?
Since the 2016 reform, metropolitan France has had 13 regions. With the five overseas regions, there are 18.
71b59108: Which river joins the Rhône in Lyon?
The Saône flows into the Rhône in Lyon, in the Confluence district.
b9ed5d59: Which mountain range separates France from Spain?
The Pyrenees stretch about 430 km from the Atlantic to the Mediterranean.
c302dc40: Which French island is nicknamed the “Island of Beauty”?
Corsica, in the Mediterranean, is nicknamed l'Île de Beauté. Napoleon was born there, in Ajaccio.
bc6c6606: On which French island in the Indian Ocean is the Piton de la Fournaise?
The Piton de la Fournaise, on Réunion Island, is one of the most active volcanoes in the world.
87f54d1a: What is the second most populous city in France?
Marseille is France's second-largest municipality by population, ahead of Lyon and Toulouse.
02e77983: Which city is the capital of the Brittany region?
Rennes is the capital of Brittany. Nantes, historically Breton, is part of the Pays de la Loire region.
e9b024ea: Which country is shaped like a boot?
The Italian peninsula looks like a boot, with Sicily at its toe.
4470e160: Which principality lies in the Pyrenees, between France and Spain?
Andorra is a principality whose two co-princes are the President of France and the Bishop of Urgell.
2bbcaf90: In which country is the temple of Angkor Wat?
Angkor Wat, built in the 12th century, is the largest religious monument in the world. It appears on Cambodia's flag.
d60646a5: In which country is the ancient city of Petra?
Petra, carved into rose-colored rock by the Nabataeans, is in southern Jordan.
6e89acb0: Which canal links the Atlantic Ocean to the Pacific Ocean?
Opened in 1914, the Panama Canal spares ships the long voyage around South America.
dcd1c21c: Which sea does the Ukrainian port of Odesa lie on?
Odesa is Ukraine's main port on the Black Sea.
d24fafef: Madagascar, the fourth largest island in the world, lies in the Indian Ocean, off Mozambique.
bac339d6: On which continent does the Sahara Desert lie?
The Sahara covers much of northern Africa. It is the largest hot desert in the world.
8017f0fd: On which continent are the Andes mountains?
The Andes run along the entire west coast of South America, for more than 7,000 km.
10c62401: What is the largest country in Africa by area?
With about 2.38 million km², Algeria has been Africa's largest country since Sudan split in 2011.
dc7fd199: What is the largest hot desert in the world?
The Sahara covers about 9 million km². Only polar deserts, such as Antarctica, are larger.
823c933f: In which country is Angel Falls, the highest waterfall in the world?
Angel Falls, in Venezuela, drops about 979 m. It is the highest waterfall in the world.
96f9e64b: What is the longest river in South America?
The Amazon carries more water than any other river in the world, and its length rivals that of the Nile.
